notes.title: InnerSpace Free Content Update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11792196/e17069fd50586ca0abb04e09409f6fd78f5dc69a.jpg[/img]
Salutations explorers!

InnerSpace has been live for almost three months now, and we’ve been listening closely to our players and to critic reviews. As a small team of just seven developers, we are always trying to learn and improve, so we’re super excited to deliver our free content update. This update addresses a lot of critical feedback, offers new airframes for new playstyles, and adds customizations designed by our very own Kickstarter backers!

[h1]Without further ado, here are our two new airframes, the Hopper and Glass Piano.[/h1]

[b]Hopper:[/b] A craft for slow contemplation and observation. This airframe stops completely when drifting, allowing players to look around without fear of crashing. It also sports a nifty compass that always points towards the world’s center, which is the closest thing the Inverse has to “North.”

[b]Glass Piano:[/b] A fragile variant of the piano airframe. A lot of players came away with the impression that you can’t die in InnerSpace. Technically this isn’t true, and we wanted to give intrepid pilots the chance to make their own legend. This airframe shares most stats with the regular Piano but is much easier to break. This is our way of adding HARD MODE. Good luck!

[h1]Full update notes below. And remember, your greatest journey is within![/h1]

[b]Airframes:[/b]
[*]Added unlockable airframe skins! Visit the Archaeologist to unlock new colors for all of your airframes.
[*]Added 2 new relics: Hopper Wing (Sunchamber) and Glass Wing (Dawnvessel).
[*]Added 2 new planes: Hopper and Glass Piano. Hopper can stop completely when drifting, whereas Glass Piano is a fragile, challenge-mode plane.
[*]Woodwind airframe has a much slower brake speed, so learning the game is easier for new players in the tutorial.
[*]Zephyr Spark airframe drift/airbrake is slower and has faster turning speeds.[/list]

[b]Game-Wide Improvements:[/b]
[*]Revised Archaeologist dialogue for Sunchamber discussions, especially if you're looking for help or hints.
[*]Added an inspector pillar for the statue in Mornsea.
[*]Added an inspector pillar for new statues in the Eventide.
[*]Respawning rope interactions change color if they’ve been cut before. 
[*]Added a relic-counter to pause menu.
[*]Invert button on start-screen fixed.
[*]Various minor bug fixes. [/list]

[b]P.S.[/b] For those of you interested in a [b]photo-mode[/b], combine the Hopper airframe with the invisible skin to get wide-angle stills!

notes.title: Patch 1: Feb 5, 2018
notes.notes:
Explorers!

Our first update to InnerSpace has just flipped live. Hop back in and let us know your thoughts! Don't forget to leave us a Steam review too.

Full patch notes below.

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added two interactions with Sun in Sunchamber: large Wind globule added after first collision & the sun regenerates to full brightness over time
[*]Added additional wind to the Sunchamber and Eventide to improve signposting
[*]Added baby sunfish to the Dawnvessel
[*]Added scenic shots to the Archaeologist's opening dialogue in the Sunchamber
[/list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where Duskprism boss would be invisible for multiple cutscenes 
[*]Small tweaks to improve visibility in low-light scenarios 
[*]Fixed a bug where players weren’t able to view the world-scale holograms in Eventide. 
[*]Various bug fixes
[*]Various performance improvements
[/list]
[h1]Tuning[/h1]
[list]
[*]Grouped towers leading to other worlds in Sunchamber by color
[*]Improved signposting in Sunchamber cutscenes
[*]Removed redundant lines of dialogue in Archaeologist interactions
[*]Improvements to the Sunfish encounter
[*]Updated some plane models to better show when Drift is active 
[*]Updated credits
[/list]
